releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.4.10

- Repairs ANS Recharge, Nightly Recharge, lowest sleep heart rate, skin-temperature, SpO2, and current Polar VO2-max reads by using Polar's supported AccessLink v3 endpoints.
- Shows Polar readiness as six colored circles with a parenthetical percentage while preserving Intervals.icu colors for Intervals-sourced values.
- Can safely fill a missing dated Polar VO2-max value in Intervals.icu without overwriting an existing value or copying Polar weight.
- Keeps Wyze smart-scale weight and Apple Health-only data on the existing iPhone Health Sync path instead of adding a less-reliable duplicate importer.
- Packages a bicycle Finder icon inside the app and keeps the compact bicycle in the menu bar.
